digest.component_or_area: llm provider session management in runner
propositions: ProviderSession construction at runner.py:294 sits outside the try-finally guard (lines 294–444), so exceptions raised during tool capability checks and provider resolution leak open httpx.AsyncClient instances
ProviderSession already implements __enter__ and __exit__ at providers.py:323-326 but run() never uses the context manager protocol, leaving the documented caller (providers.py:18–24) nonexistent
The pre-call security gate assert_gated('agentic filesystem tools') at runner.py:261 must execute before any provider client is constructed to maintain fail-closed ordering
Test stub _NoBuildProviderSession lacks __enter__/__exit__ methods and will break when run() switches to `with ProviderSession(cfg) as` syntax
Wrapping run() in `with ProviderSession(cfg) as session:` and removing the redundant `finally: provider_session.close()` eliminates the leak while preserving best-effort close semantics
